lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪੈ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat vasahi charanaarabi(n)d rasanaa japai gupaal ||
lines.translation: Let the Lotus Feet of the Lord abide within your heart, and with your tongue, chant God's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ ਪਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so prabh simareeai tis dehee kau paal ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditate in remembrance on God, and nurture this body. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape athasath teerath karataa aap kare isanaan ||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself is the sixty-eight sacred places of pilgrimage; He Himself takes the cleansing bath in them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sa(n)jam varatai svaamee aap japaaihi naam ||
lines.translation: He Himself practices austere self-discipline; the Lord Master Himself causes us to chant His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਭਉ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap daiaal hoi bhau kha(n)dan aap karai sabh daan ||
lines.translation: He Himself becomes merciful to us; the Destroyer of fear Himself gives in charity to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no guramukh aap bujhaae so sad hee daragahi paae maan ||
lines.translation: One whom He has enlightened and made Gurmukh, ever obtains honor in His Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: jis dee paij rakhai har suaamee so sachaa har jaan ||14||
lines.translation: One whose honor the Lord Master has preserved, comes to know the True Lord. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਗੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bin satigur bhete jag a(n)dh hai a(n)dhe karam kamaai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without meeting the True Guru, the world is blind, and it does blind deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਵਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabadai siu chit na laavaee jit sukh vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: It does not focus its consciousness on the Word of the Shabad, which would bring peace to abide in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਮਸਿ ਲਗਾ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਲਤੁ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taamas lagaa sadaa phirai ahinis jalat bihaai ||
lines.translation: Always afflicted with the dark passions of low energy, it wanders around, passing its days and nights burning.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||1||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass; no one has any say in this. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰੀ ਏਹ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satiguroo phuramaaiaa kaaree eh karehu ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has commanded us to do this:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਮਾਲੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guroo duaarai hoi kai saahib sa(n)maalehu ||
lines.translation: through the Guru's Gate, meditate on the Lord Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਕੇ ਛਉੜ ਕਟਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib sadaa hajoor hai bharamai ke chhauR kat kai a(n)tar jot dharehu ||
lines.translation: The Lord Master is ever-present. He tears away the veil of doubt, and installs His Light within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਏਹੁ ਲਾਏਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam a(n)mrit hai daaroo ehu laaehu ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar - take this healing medicine!

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa chit rakhahu sa(n)jam sachaa nehu ||
lines.translation: Enshrine the Will of the True Guru in your consciousness, and make the True Lord's Love your self-discipline.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aithai sukhai a(n)dar rakhasee agai har siu kel karehu ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, you shall be kept in peace here, and hereafter, you shall celebrate with the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਬਣਸਪਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape bhaar athaarah banasapat aape hee phal laae ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the vast variety of Nature, and He Himself makes it bear fruit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਲੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਸਿੰਚੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape maalee aap sabh si(n)chai aape hee muhi paae ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Gardener, He Himself irrigates all the plants, and He Himself puts them in His mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape karataa aape bhugataa aape dei divaae ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer; He Himself gives, and causes others to give.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਰਾਖਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape saahib aape hai raakhaa aape rahiaa samaae ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the Protector; He Himself is permeating and pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak vadiaaee aakhai har karate kee jis no til na tamaae ||15||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak speaks of the greatness of the Lord, the Creator, who has no greed at all. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਆਣਿਆ ਮਾਣਸੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanas bhariaa aaniaa maanas bhariaa aai ||
lines.translation: One person brings a full bottle, and another fills his cup.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਰਲੁ ਪਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit peetai mat door hoi baral pavai vich aai ||
lines.translation: Drinking the wine, his intelligence departs, and madness enters his mind;

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਧਕੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa paraaiaa na pachhaanaee khasamahu dhake khaai ||
lines.translation: he cannot distinguish between his own and others, and he is struck down by his Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit peetai khasam visarai daragah milai sajaai ||
lines.translation: Drinking it, he forgets his Lord and Master, and he is punished in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਮਦੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪੀਚਈ ਜੇ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothaa mad mool na peechaee je kaa paar vasaai ||
lines.translation: Do not drink the false wine at all, if it is in your power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree sach mad paaeeai satigur milai jis aai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True Guru comes and meets the mortal; by His Grace, one obtains the True Wine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa saahib kai ra(n)g rahai mahalee paavai thaau ||1||
lines.translation: He shall dwell forever in the Love of the Lord Master, and obtain a seat in the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਜਾ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jagat jeevat marai jaa is no sojhee hoi ||
lines.translation: When this world comes to understand, it remains dead while yet alive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਨੑਿ ਸਵਾਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਸਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਾਏ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa tinhi savaaliaa taa(n) sav rahiaa jagaae taa(n) sudh hoi ||
lines.translation: When the Lord puts him to sleep, he remains asleep; when He wakes him up, he regains consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadar kare je aapanee satigur melai soi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, He causes him to meet the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad jeevat marai taa phir maran na hoi ||2||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, remain dead while yet alive, and you shall not have to die again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis daa keetaa sabh kichh hovai tis no paravaah naahee kisai keree ||
lines.translation: By His doing, everything happens; what does He care for anyone else?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਖਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਕਢੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu teraa ditaa sabh ko khaavai sabh muhataajee kadhai teree ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, everyone eats whatever You give - all are subservient to You.
